During the [[Raid on Picutorion|Battle of Picutorion]], [[Tensiger]] commanded the '''6th regiment''', which contained both ground [[Soldier/Legends|troops]] and an [[Armor/Legends|armor]] [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]]. They assaulted an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]]-held [[tracking station]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ganig]] and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Stecker]] were members of the [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]].<ref name="Picutorion" />
